name: pxm
author: ysrdevs
description: Local PHP development for Omarchy, in the spirit of Laravel Herd, from a bar icon and an app window. Every folder in your sites folder becomes https://<folder>.test with a trusted certificate. Switch PHP and Node versions per project, run MySQL, PostgreSQL, Redis and Mailpit, and give any site a public link. Run pxm setup once after installing.

barWidget.description: PHP and Node versions, your .test sites, sharing and dev services.
